sloka: तौ प्रयुद्धौ तदा वीरौ मृधे लक्ष्मणराक्षसौ।शरौघानभिवर्षन्तौ जघ्नतुस्तौ परस्परम् ।। ६.९०.२७ ।।
transliteration: tau prayuddhau tadā vīrau mṛdhe lakṣmaṇarākṣasau।śaraughānabhivarṣantau jaghnatustau parasparam ।। 6.90.27 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Indrajith who can give tough fight to enemies gave a violent fight to his father's brother and again rushed towards Lakshmana.
